component.name: VibeStudio
component.summary: The all-in-one development studio for classic idTech games

description.p: VibeStudio brings level editing, models, textures, audio, packages, code, compiler orchestration and game launching for Doom, Quake, Quake II and Quake III-era projects into one studio, with a command line that shares the same services.
VibeStudio is pre-alpha and largely untested in real projects. Keep backups of your work while you try it.
